drafter.private_reasoning: Since this is the first round and we want to move the deal forward while preserving negotiation leverage, I will clarify language for both compensation and severance to request specific terms (increasing the negotiation anchor), yet leave some room for further negotiation. For severance, I'll propose a substantial but not final amount, above what we expect to settle for. I'll also clarify 'Base Salary' and 'Severance Amount' as defined terms, and make sure the benefits are explicitly stated to prompt the other side for detail. The cover note will remain friendly, signal willingness to make progress, and invite any initial concerns.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Dear Opposing Counsel,

Please find attached our redline of the draft Executive Employment Agreement. We have proposed clarifying language on compensation and severance, and set out proposed figures for ease of discussion. We look forward to your feedback and are happy to discuss any preliminary concerns.

Best regards,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: The Executive shall receive an annual Base Salary of USD 1,250,000, payable in accordance with Company payroll practices, plus standard Company benefits including health, dental, and retirement benefits as provided to similarly situated executives.
edits.name: Clarify and specify Base Salary and benefits.

edits.text: On termination without cause, the Executive shall receive a Severance Amount equal to twenty-four (24) months of Base Salary, payable in a lump sum within ten (10) business days of termination.
edits.name: Specify Severance Amount and strengthen payment timing.

receiver.message_back: Thank you for your redline. We note your proposed annual Base Salary of USD 1,250,000 and a severance amount representing 24 months' salary paid promptly upon termination without cause. These figures are considerably above current market benchmarks for comparable positions and require substantial downward revision; we look forward to receiving revised, market-appropriate proposals on both compensation and severance in your next draft.

drafter.private_reasoning: The opposing side is pushing back on both the salary (USD 1,250,000) and the severance (24 months) as being above 'market.' To keep momentum and show willingness to compromise, we should propose figures closer to the market, but still leave ourselves room for another round if needed — ideally anchoring the compromise just above market. A typical COO Base Salary might sit around USD 950,000-1,100,000, and severance at 12-18 months. I will propose USD 1,100,000 and 18 months' severance to keep us in a strong but credible position.

Please see our updated draft reflecting these terms. We look forward to your feedback and working toward a mutually acceptable agreement.
